title: Clamped input condition
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-tape Turing machine with Boolean tape alphabet, let $v$ be a Boolean valuation on its atoms, let $\rho$ specify an optional input symbol and the read symbols on its work tapes, and let $m$ be a sign. The condition holds exactly when the input symbol in $\rho$ is absent and the symbol encoded by the $t_c$ answer atom of type $a_1$, with no work tape selected and with Boolean parameter true precisely when $m$ is negative, is absent.
